steps.eval: (() => { const aside = document.querySelector('aside'); const width = Math.round(aside.getBoundingClientRect().width); if (width !== 56) throw new Error('折叠态宽度应为 56px，实际 ' + width); const create = aside.querySelector('button[aria-label="新建分组"]'); if (!create) throw new Error('折叠态缺少新建分组入口'); if (!create.getAttribute('title')) throw new Error('折叠态新建分组缺少 title 提示'); const groupButtons = [...aside.querySelectorAll('button[aria-pressed]')]; if (groupButtons.length < 2) throw new Error('折叠态缺少分组图标按钮: ' + groupButtons.length); if (document.querySelectorAll('[data-sidebar-count]').length !== 0) throw new Error('折叠态不应残留计数槽'); return { width, groupButtons: groupButtons.length, createTitle: create.getAttribute('title') }; })()

(() => { const width = Math.round(document.querySelector('aside').getBoundingClientRect().width); if (width !== 180) throw new Error('展开后宽度应回到 180，实际 ' + width); if (!document.querySelector('[data-sidebar-head="groups"]')) throw new Error('展开后分组头部没有回来'); return { width }; })()
